messages.en:

furniture, {04 1f 00}?{02 00 00 08 09}
You know it!
Nope.

{07 15 00}Even a girl like me has got
problems sometimes,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0e 00}You know, like{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.do I move
my furniture here, or would
it look better over there?
{07 0f 00}Phew{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Life can be pretty
tough sometimes.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Isegi minusugusel tüdrukul
on vahel probleeme,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0f 00}Uhh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Elu võib vahel

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I wonder {07 0b 00}what {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook {ff 00 00 00}is
gonna have in his store
tomorrow?!
{07 06 00}There's NO WAY I'm gonna
sleep until I know,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Huvitav, {07 0b 00}mida on {ff 00 00 06}Tom
Nookil{ff 00 00 00} homme poes?!

{07 06 00}Ma EI SAA kuidagi magada,
enne kui tean,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I spilled sauce over, like,
ALL my clothes, so I had
to buy all new clothes!
But my drawers were
already full, so I had to
buy a new wardrobe{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0f 00}I've never been so
depressed about shopping in
my life, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ajasin kastet, nagu,
KÕIGILE oma riietele, nii et
pidin ostma kõik uued!
Aga mu sahtlid olid
juba täis, nii et pidin
ostma uue riidekapi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0f 00}Ma pole elus kunagi
ostlemise pärast nii kurb
olnud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Getting way too obsessed
with collecting furniture
is kinda geeky.
{07 14 00}But sometimes I just have
these{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}cravings,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Liiga suur kinnisidee
mööbli kogumisest
on natuke nohiklik.
{07 14 00}Aga vahel tulevad mul
lihtsalt{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}isud,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Furniture from the same
set looks really hot
together, {01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}At least, that's what
{04 0d 00} tells me.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sama komplekti mööbel
näeb koos tõesti kuum
välja, {01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Vähemalt nii ütleb
{04 0d 00} mulle.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I'm pretty happy with 
my room now. {07 14 00}I don't think
I need any more stuff.
{07 0d 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}it's not like I'd
complain if you hooked me
up with something sweet!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma olen oma toaga praegu
päris rahul. {07 14 00}Ma vist ei
vaja rohkem kraami.
{07 0d 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}ega ma ei kurdaks,
kui sa mulle midagi
magusat hangiksid!

{07 1c 00}Uhh{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ehk on aeg lõpuks
oma tuba koristada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Või äkki teeksid sa seda
minu eest, {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Sa oled ju nii lahe!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Fine! {01 00 00 05 00}From now on, this
means furniture war!

{07 11 00}I'll buy up ALL the good
furniture at {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}'s
shop before you!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hästi! {01 00 00 05 00}Nüüdsest tähendab
see mööblisõda!

{07 11 00}Ma ostan {ff 00 00 06}Tom Nooki{ff 00 00 00} poest
KOGU hea mööbli
enne sind ära!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}That's good to know!


I almost started some
serious drama over some
furniture, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
